meta.title: MIW — websites, products and AI tools from Prague
meta.description: MIW is a team of seven in Prague. We build websites, online stores and automation for small businesses, and MVPs and AI features for startups — and we build our own products.

footer.replyIn: We reply within one working day.

home.lede: Seven people in Prague. We build websites, online stores and automation for small businesses, and MVPs and AI features for startups.
home.transmissionBody: A few lines are enough. A person from the team reads every message and replies.

contact.replyNote: A person from the team, not a bot.

notFound.title: This page is not on our map.
notFound.body: The link may be old, or there is a typo in the address. Everything we do is one click from here.

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.title: A small request from the crew
cookies.body: May we keep one cookie in the cargo hold? It only remembers your language. No tracking, no analytics.

error.label: Error
error.title: Something broke on our side.
error.body: The page could not be shown. Try again; if it fails a second time, the rest of the site is one click away.
